messages:
product-lead: Quick internal announce: Async Generation v1 is GA. This introduces `async-gen` endpoints for fire-and-forget / job-style generation, improved function/tool-calling semantics for long-running ops, and a new job-status webhook for notifications. Internal docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/async-gen (internal).

product-lead: TL;DR: 1) New endpoints: `/v2/async-generate` and `/v2/async-status`. 2) SDKs (py/js) add `client.async.create_job()` + `client.async.stream_status()`. 3) Webhooks: `job.completed` and `job.failed` with structured payloads. 4) Pricing: job-based billing (per-job overhead + per-token). Early-adopter credits for first 90 days. 5) Deprecation: old long-poll patterns will be supported but flagged for removal in 120 days.

devx: Migration notes: minimal changes for most users. Example (python):
```python
job = client.async.create_job(model='gen-async-v1', input='Generate long report...', callback_url='https://hooks.example.com/rdwd')
# poll if you prefer
status = client.async.get_status(job.id)
while status.state in ('pending','running'):
    time.sleep(2)
    status = client.async.get_status(job.id)
```
Webhooks deliver `job.completed` with `result_url` for retrieval.

eng-runtime: For infra: jobs are queued with priority hints (low/med/high). We added `x-rdwd-job-priority` and `x-rdwd-job-estimate-ms` headers. Large jobs auto-sampled for quality checks. If runtime moves job to fallback model you'll see `x-rdwd-fallback:true`.

sre-oncall: Canary: infra bot scheduled gradual rollout starting 2145680000 (5%->25%->75%->100% over 6h). Watch signals: job-queue-length, job-failure-rate, webhook-delivery-failures. Oncall pinned for first 48h.

deploy-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary start=2145680000 stages=5%->25%->75%->100% (~6h) rollback-window=2h. Secrets: async/jobs/canary/*. Webhook retry policy: 3 retries with exponential backoff.

billing: Billing change: job overhead billed as 1 unit minimum + per-token. Early-adopter credits applied automatically for accounts created before the end of the promo. We'll post detailed pricing table in Console tomorrow.

partners: Will partners get webhook signing keys? Need to coordinate with partner integrations team for early customers.

product-lead: Partner note: yes, signing keys in secrets manager under `async/webhook_signing/*`. Also added a partner guide for durable jobs and idempotency keys.

devx: SDK behavior: minor bumps only. We'll emit deprecation warnings for legacy long-poll patterns starting 60 days out. Also added `client.async.stream_status()` helper for streaming updates from status endpoint.

sre-oncall: Observability: new dashboards Console -> Jobs -> async-gen: job-latency-p50/p95, queue-depth, webhook-success-rate. Alerts: job-failure-rate>0.5% (5m) and webhook-drop-rate>0.2% (5m).

product-lead: Launch readout + runbook walk-through tomorrow 10:00 PT in #release-war-room. Runbook, rollback plan, and quick-tests posted. Huge thanks to eng-runtime, devx, SRE, and billing for the launch :tada:
